Imports a list of prompts into a prompt set and returns the updated set. Send an Idempotency-Key header so a retry within 24 hours never runs it twice.

get.description: Lists the candidate prompts a generation run proposed and nobody has accepted or rejected yet. Review them with the candidate review operation.

post.description: Accepts or rejects candidate prompts by id. Accepted candidates become prompts of the set. Send an Idempotency-Key header so a retry within 24 hours never runs it twice.

patch.description: Changes a prompt’s text, classification, topic, status (active or archived) or whether it runs. This is how to activate, archive or refile a prompt. Send only the fields to change; the updated prompt is returned.

delete.description: Deletes a prompt from its prompt set. Answers already recorded for it stay in past audits.

post.description: Files up to 500 of the project’s prompts under one topic in one change; topic_id null takes them out of every topic. Past runs keep the topic they froze. Every id must be a prompt of the project, or nothing changes, and an active prompt that does not fit the topic refuses the whole change. Returns how many prompts were filed. Send an Idempotency-Key header so a retry within 24 hours never runs it twice.

Deletes up to 500 of the project’s prompts in one change. Every id must be a prompt of the project, or nothing is deleted. Answers already recorded stay in past audits. Returns how many prompts were deleted. Send an Idempotency-Key header so a retry within 24 hours never runs it twice.

get.description: Lists the topics that organise the project’s prompts, including nested topics.

post.description: Creates a topic, optionally under a parent topic, and returns it. Send an Idempotency-Key header so a retry within 24 hours never runs it twice.

patch.description: Renames a topic, changes its description or moves it under another parent.

delete.description: Deletes a topic. Its prompts are kept.

post.description: Creates a schedule that launches audits of a prompt set on a cadence and returns it. Send an Idempotency-Key header so a retry within 24 hours never runs it twice.

get.description: Lists the schedules that launch the project’s audits automatically.
Returns one audit schedule with its cadence, time zone and engines.

patch.description: Changes a schedule’s prompt set, cadence, time zone or engines. Send only the fields to change.

delete.description: Deletes a schedule. Audits it already launched are kept.

get.description: Returns one audit with its status and progress. A launched audit is queued and runs on its own, so poll this to see it finish.

post.description: Stops an audit that has not finished and returns it. Answers already recorded are kept. Send an Idempotency-Key header so a retry within 24 hours never runs it twice.

get.description: Returns the projects the key can reach, one page at a time. A key limited to some projects lists only those. Start here to find the project_id every other path needs.
Lists the project’s prompt sets. A prompt set is the group of prompts an audit runs together.
Lists the project’s prompts, one page at a time. Filter by prompt set, topic or status. Each prompt carries its latest measurement, which is measured, not measured or unavailable.

post.description: Adds a batch of prompts to a prompt set and returns the created prompts. Send an Idempotency-Key header so a retry within 24 hours never runs it twice.

get.description: Lists the prompt generation runs of a prompt set, newest first, one page at a time.
Lists the competitors the project tracks, with the names, aliases and domains used to recognise them in answers.

post.description: Starts tracking a competitor by name, aliases and domains, and returns it. Send an Idempotency-Key header so a retry within 24 hours never runs it twice.

patch.description: Changes a competitor’s name, aliases or domains. Send only the fields to change.

delete.description: Stops tracking a competitor. Answers already recorded keep what they found.

get.description: Lists the project’s audits, newest first, one page at a time.

post.description: Queues an audit of a prompt set, or of chosen prompts, on the engines you name, and returns the created audits. Each recorded answer spends one prompt run; set max_attempts to cap the spend, and estimate first with the estimate operation. Send an Idempotency-Key header so a retry within 24 hours never runs it twice.

Returns the number of answers an audit would ask for and its maximum attempt count, without creating anything. Pass the maximum as max_attempts when launching to cap the cost. It needs only the read scope.
